records.title: 1667 帝国外围地方控制脱离观察
records.description: 原文记多部族退出征发且Karshyr脱离。用仍留本地核心/原名的Asarta、Alashkatsa、Lata、Karashan作为临时地方继承候选，1667为第一战后观察点；不证明这些旧TAG同年正式复国。Karshyr和Arazin解除上层，S15保持所有权。 本步骤为可关闭地图假说；选年与整省边界不等于已确证转属日期。原始native/tribal及投影不改。

sourceExpressions: 1666 AA - Yezel Mora invades Khatalashya via Lake Adgur, completely crushing the 333rd’s armies. The lands around Lake Ichiadza are completely overrun, as many flee towards Kuiika, at this point renamed to Irikini, which becomes a temporary capital. Many tribes break away from the 333rd, refusing to be drafted into a slaughter, including Karshyr among the others.
TLDR记Karshyr在帝国瓦解后独立、主体没有遭入侵，转向Amiratsamo；约90%人口为Shagashay与Karshyray、接近各半。该人口是文档开局叙述，无取得各省的时间。
